title: Demonstrative grid and gap-fill
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 19 (Demonstrative grid and gap-fill (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 19: This and that: demonstratives with gender. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Point to a far-away school (مَدْرَسَة): 'That is my school.'

blocks.title: Sort into: هٰذَا / هٰذِهِ / ذٰلِكَ / تِلْكَ
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: هٰذَا, هٰذِهِ, ذٰلِكَ, تِلْكَ.
blocks.answer: هٰذَا: near pen; near brother. هٰذِهِ: near bag. ذٰلِكَ: far house. تِلْكَ: far school; far sister

questions.q: Say: This is my uncle's house.
Core: Fill in هٰذَا / هٰذِهِ / ذٰلِكَ / تِلْكَ: 1) ___ أَبِي (near) 2) ___ أُخْتِي (far) 3) ___ مَسْجِدٌ كَبِيرٌ (far) 4) ___ غُرْفَتِي (near) 5) ___ حَدِيقَةُ جَدِّي (far)
Extend: Write four sentences pointing out family members and things at a family gathering (two near, two far).
questions.a: For example: هٰذَا عَمِّي. هٰذِهِ عَمَّتِي. ذٰلِكَ جَدِّي. تِلْكَ سَيَّارَتُهُ.

questions.q: Stretch: Translate: That is my cousin and this is her book.

questions.a: C) تِلْكَ سَيَّارَةٌ. Far and feminine: تِلْكَ.

questions.q: 'That' for a feminine noun is: A) ذٰلِكَ B) تِلْكَ C) هٰذِهِ
Big question: what two questions decide which demonstrative to use?
questions.a: Is it near or far? Is the noun masculine or feminine?
